source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban artificial intelligence" OR "urban AI" OR "AI urbanism" OR "city brain"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban artificial intelligence" OR "urban AI" OR "AI urbanism" OR "city brain",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("AI urbanism" OR "city brain" OR "urban AI" OR "urban artificial intelligence")
